Package corewar.redcode

Class InstructionFactory

java.lang.Object
corewar.redcode.InstructionFactory
public class InstructionFactory extends Object
A factory class responsible for parsing Redcode text and generating Instruction and Warrior objects. It handles both file reading and raw string parsing.
